info.title: Mountain Hut API
info.description: API endpoints for authentication, defining the tables of each slot, checking meal-slot availability, booking a table and changing a booking. Authentication uses a server-side session identified by the `sid` cookie. An id that does not exist, in the path or in the body, is a 404; a rule of the hut that is not met is a 422; a request that conflicts with what is stored is a 409.

post.description: Creates a hiker account and logs the new hiker in: the response sets the session cookie. Only hikers can sign up; the role is always `HIKER` and cannot be sent in the request (any field not listed in the request body is rejected with 400). Employee and warden accounts are not created here. Names and email are trimmed. The email is stored in lowercase and is unique, compared without regard to letter case. The `repeat password` field of the form is checked in the browser and is not sent.

201.description: Account created and hiker logged in.

Set-Cookie.description: Session cookie `sid`. It is `HttpOnly` and `SameSite=Lax`, and `Secure` when the server runs behind HTTPS. It expires when the session does (24 hours by default, set by the server). The session id is regenerated on every login or sign up.

400.description: The request body is invalid: it is not a JSON object or not valid JSON, it has a field that is not allowed, a required field is missing or blank, the email is not a valid email, the phone has characters other than digits and spaces (a leading `+` is allowed), or the password has fewer than 8 characters. The `message` says which check failed.

value.message: firstName is required
email must be a valid email
phone must contain only digits, spaces and a leading +
password must have at least 8 characters
Unknown field: role
Request body must be valid JSON

409.description: An account with this email already exists. The client shows the message under the email field, with a link to log in.

example.message: An account with this email already exists

post.description: One login for every role (hiker, employee, warden). On success the response sets the session cookie and returns the user, whose `role` the client uses to choose the page after login and the navbar. The error never says which of the two credentials was wrong. A user who is already logged in gets a new session. The email is trimmed and compared without regard to letter case.

Set-Cookie.description: Session cookie `sid`. It is `HttpOnly` and `SameSite=Lax`, and `Secure` when the server runs behind HTTPS. It expires when the session does (24 hours by default, set by the server). The session id is regenerated on every login or sign up.

400.description: The email or the password is missing, the body has a field that is not allowed, or the body is not valid JSON. The login form checks the first case in the browser, so this answer is a safeguard.

value.message: email and password are required
Unknown field: role
Request body must be valid JSON

401.description: The email or the password is wrong.

post.description: Destroys the session and clears the session cookie. It is idempotent: it answers 204 also when there is no active session.

get.description: Returns the user of the current session. The client calls it when the app starts to restore who is logged in (the cookie is `HttpOnly`, so the client cannot read it), and the 401 answer means the visitor is anonymous or the session has expired.

401.description: The request has no valid authenticated session.

get.description: Returns every slot from today on, in order of day and time, with its free seats. "Today" is the day in the time zone of the hut, decided by the server: the request has no parameters. Slots that are full, have no tables yet or are already closed are listed too, so the page can show them greyed with the reason (`freeSeats`, `bookingOpen`, `bookingClosesAt`). There is no limit on how far ahead. No login is required. The availability check starts from here: the page finds in this list the slot of the chosen day and time, then asks for its seating.

200.description: The slots from today. An empty array means the hut has none.

post.summary: Book the tables of the preview
post.description: Creates a booking for an authenticated hiker on the tables of the seating preview (`GET /api/slots/{slotId}/seating`). The slot identifies the day and the time of the meal, so the body carries no date. The server works out again where the party would sit now and books the request only if it is exactly that: the same tables with the same seats. Otherwise it answers 409 and books nothing, so a hiker never gets other tables than the ones shown. The `code` of the 409 says why: `NO_SEATS` (choose another slot) or `TABLES_CHANGED` (ask for a new preview). The slot must be at least two hours away (exactly two hours is still allowed; the time of the slot is the local time of the hut). A hiker can have one booking per slot. The body can also carry the dietary needs and allergies of the guests (MH-05): one line per guest, with diets and allergies of the preset lists, an other diet and an other allergy in words, and other requests for the kitchen. They are saved with the booking, in the same transaction. The response says which tables the party got, which are the ones sent, and the saved needs, each with its allergy flag. After the booking is saved, the hiker receives a confirmation email; if the email fails, the booking still stands and the response is the same.

400.description: The request body is invalid: a wrong or unknown field (a `date` is not accepted), `tables` missing or empty, a table twice, or seats that do not add up to `partySize`, or wrong `requirements`: not a list, more lines than `partySize`, an unknown field, a diet or an allergy not in the list or twice, two of VEGETARIAN, VEGAN and PESCATARIAN, an empty or too long text, or a line that says nothing.

example.message: partySize must be a positive integer

401.description: The request has no valid authenticated session.

403.description: The authenticated user is not a hiker.

409.description: The booking is refused and nothing is booked. The `code` says why: `NO_SEATS` the party does not fit in the free seats of the slot any more; `TABLES_CHANGED` the party still fits, but not at the tables sent (someone booked in between, or they are not the tables of a preview).

noSeats.summary: The party does not fit any more: choose another slot

value.message: Not enough free seats

tablesChanged.summary: The tables changed: ask for a new preview

value.message: The chosen tables are no longer the ones proposed for this party

422.description: A rule of the hut fails: the slot cannot be booked (no tables), the meal starts less than two hours from now so booking is closed, or the hiker already has a booking for that slot.

value.message: Bookings close two hours before the meal
Slot 12 is not available for booking

alreadyBooked.summary: The hiker already booked this slot

value.message: You already have a booking for this slot

get.description: The bookings of the logged-in hiker from today on (today of the hut, so today's meals are listed even when they have started), in order of day and time. Cancelled bookings are not listed. Each booking says if it can still be changed (`canChange`) and until when (`changeableUntil`): changes close 48 hours before the meal (team reading of MH-06, not confirmed by the product owner).

401.description: The request has no valid authenticated session.

403.description: The authenticated user is not a hiker.

get.summary: Check availability and where a party would sit
get.description: Checks whether a party of that size fits in the slot and tells where it would sit, without booking anything. It is the availability check (MH-04) and also the proposal that `POST /api/bookings` then confirms (MH-01). The answer comes from the free seats of the slot and from its tables: the page finds the slot of the chosen day and time in `GET /api/slots`, then asks here with its `slotId`. The whole party is seated at one table when a table has enough free seats (the one with the fewest free seats that fits); otherwise it is split over as few tables as possible, and `tables` gives the detail, for example 2 + 3 + 1 seats. A party that does not fit is not available: 409 when the free seats are too few, 422 when the slot cannot be booked at all. No other slot is suggested: to check another time, ask again with another `slotId`. Nothing is booked or held: if someone books first, the booking of those tables answers 409 and the client asks again. No login is required.

parameters.name: partySize
parameters.description: Number of people in the party.

200.description: Available. `tables` says where the party would sit, one entry for each table.

oneTable.summary: The whole party at one table

threeTablesOfTwo.summary: Six free seats over three tables of two

twoThreeOne.summary: The seats still free are 2, 3 and 1

400.description: The slot id or the party size is not a positive integer.

example.message: partySize must be a positive integer

409.description: Not available: the party does not fit in the free seats of the slot, even split over its tables.

422.description: Not available: the slot cannot be booked, because it has no tables or booking is closed (less than two hours to the meal).

value.message: Bookings close two hours before the meal
Slot 12 is not available for booking

post.description: Defines a set of tables, each with its number and its capacity (the seats it has). A table set is what is available in a slot: it is created once and can be given to any number of slots, so it does not have to be entered again. There is no fixed set: the hut can have a different one at lunch and at dinner, or when the weather changes. Only an employee or the warden can create a set.

400.description: The request body is invalid: the name is empty, there is no table, a number or a capacity is not a positive integer, or two tables have the same number.

401.description: The request has no valid authenticated session.

403.description: The authenticated user is not an employee or the warden.

example.message: Only the staff can do this

409.description: A table set with this name already exists.

example.message: A table set named Lunch, main room already exists

get.description: Returns every table set, with its tables, so that one can be given to a new slot.

200.description: The table sets. An empty array means none was created yet.

401.description: The request has no valid authenticated session.

403.description: The authenticated user is not an employee or the warden.

example.message: Only the staff can do this

post.description: Creates a meal slot on a date. The start time and the duration are free, and a day can have more than one slot (for example 12:00-13:00 and 13:00-14:00). A slot with a table set can be booked; without one it has no seats, so nothing can be booked until a table set is given to it. Only an employee or the warden can create a slot.

400.description: The request body is invalid: a date or a time is not valid, or the slot does not end after it starts.

401.description: The request has no valid authenticated session.

403.description: The authenticated user is not an employee or the warden.

example.message: Only the staff can do this

404.description: The table set does not exist.

409.description: A slot starting at the same time already exists on that date.

example.message: A slot starting at 12:00 already exists on 2026-10-28

get.summary: List the slots of a period
get.description: Returns every slot between two dates, both included, in order of date and time. It is the staff view: it also returns the slots without a table set and the ones that are full or no longer open for booking, and it shows the table set of each slot. It is also how to find a previous slot whose table set can be reused.

200.description: The slots of the period. An empty array means there is none.

400.description: A date is missing or is not a valid calendar date, or `to` is before `from`.

example.message: to must not be before from

401.description: The request has no valid authenticated session.

403.description: The authenticated user is not an employee or the warden.

example.message: Only the staff can do this

put.summary: Give a table set to a slot
put.description: Gives a table set to a slot that has none, so that the slot can be booked. The request can be repeated: giving the slot the table set it already has changes nothing and is answered with 200. The same set can be given to many slots. Giving a different table set to a slot that already has one is a 409, because changing it is not done here: it is the modification of the slot, and the bookings it has must be kept.

200.description: The slot, now with its table set. Also the answer when the slot already had that very table set.

example.message: tableSetId must be a positive integer

401.description: The request has no valid authenticated session.

403.description: The authenticated user is not an employee or the warden.

example.message: Only the staff can do this

404.description: The slot does not exist, or the table set does not exist.

value.message: Slot 13 does not exist

tableSetNotFound.summary: The table set does not exist

value.message: Table set 3 does not exist

409.description: The slot already has a different table set.

example.message: Slot 13 already has a different table set

patch.description: Changes the slot, the party size, the dietary needs of a booking, or some of them (MH-06). Only the hiker who made the booking can change it, until 48 hours before the meal; a new slot must also be at least 48 hours away. A new slot or party size is seated again like a new booking in that slot (product owner, issue #38): the seats of the booking count as free, so it can keep or reuse them, and the server chooses the tables. There is no preview: the change succeeds, or it is refused and nothing changes. A change of the dietary needs only does not check the seats and keeps the tables. After the change, the hiker receives an email "Your booking has changed" with the same booking reference, the new details and the moment of the change; it says that it replaces the earlier emails of that booking. If the email fails, the change still stands.

200.description: The booking as it is now.

400.description: The request is invalid: a wrong `bookingId`, no field, an unknown field, a wrong `slotId` or `partySize`, or wrong `requirements` (same rules as when booking, and more lines than the `partySize` sent).

example.message: Send at least one of slotId, partySize and requirements

401.description: The request has no valid authenticated session.

403.description: The authenticated user is not a hiker.

404.description: The booking does not exist or is not of this hiker, or the new slot does not exist.

value.message: Booking 45 not found
Slot 13 not found

409.description: Nothing changes. `code` `NO_SEATS`: the party does not fit in the free seats of the slot. `code` `BOOKING_CHANGED`: another change of the same booking was saved at the same moment; reload the booking and try again.

value.message: Not enough free seats
The booking was changed in the meantime: reload it and try again

422.description: A rule of the hut fails: the meal of the booking or of the new slot is less than 48 hours away, the booking was cancelled, the new slot has no tables, the hiker already has a booking for the new slot, or there are more lines of dietary needs than people.

value.message: Bookings can be changed until 48 hours before the meal

alreadyBooked.summary: Already booked in the new slot

value.message: You already have a booking for this slot
There can be at most one requirement per person of the party

slotId.description: Identifier of the meal slot on the requested date.

partySize.description: Number of hikers included in the booking.

tables.description: The tables of the seating preview, unchanged. Each table appears once and the seats add up to `partySize`.

requirements.description: Optional. The dietary needs and allergies of the party (MH-05): one line per guest who has any, so at most `partySize` lines. Omitted or empty: no needs.

slotId.description: Identifier of the booked meal slot.

partySize.description: Number of hikers included in the booking.

tables.description: The tables chosen for the party, by table number.

requirements.description: The dietary needs saved with the booking, one line per guest, in the order they were sent. Empty when there are none.

message.description: Human-readable error description, in English, written by the server. The client can show it as it is.

code.description: Present on some 409 answers only, so the client can tell the cases apart: `NO_SEATS` the party does not fit in the free seats of the slot (choose another slot); `TABLES_CHANGED` the party still fits, but not at the tables sent (ask for a new preview).

firstName.description: First name. Surrounding spaces are removed; it cannot be blank.

lastName.description: Last name. Surrounding spaces are removed; it cannot be blank.

email.description: Email address, stored in lowercase. Booking confirmations are sent here.

phone.description: Optional. Digits and spaces, with an optional leading `+`; no maximum length for now. An empty string or null counts as not given. The hut uses it only if the hiker's plans change.

startsAt.description: Local start time of the meal, as HH:MM (the time of the hut).

endsAt.description: Local end time of the meal, as HH:MM (the time of the hut).

freeSeats.description: Seats still free in the slot. 0 when it is full or has no tables yet. A party up to this number can be seated: it is split over tables when no single table is big enough.

bookingOpen.description: True while a hiker can still book this slot: booking closes two hours before the meal.

bookingClosesAt.description: When booking closes (or closed), as the local date and time of the hut, without time zone: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

tableNumber.description: The number of the table, as the hiker reads it (not an internal id).

seats.description: Seats of the party at that table.

SeatingPlan.description: Where a party would sit: the answer of the availability check, and the proposal that `POST /api/bookings` confirms.

tables.description: The tables the party would get, by table number: the detail of the answer, for example 2 + 3 + 1 seats. One table when the whole party fits at one.

tableNumber.description: Number of the table, unique in its table set.

capacity.description: Capacity of the table: the number of seats it has.

name.description: Name of the table set, unique.

totalSeats.description: Sum of the capacities of all the tables.

name.description: Name of the table set, for example "Lunch, main room".

tables.description: The tables of the set. Two tables cannot have the same number.

startsAt.description: Local start time of the slot.

endsAt.description: Local end time of the slot, after the start.

tableSetId.description: Table set of the slot. Without it the slot has no seats and cannot be booked yet.
Table set to give to the slot.

startsAt.description: Local start time of the slot.

endsAt.description: Local end time of the slot.

tableSet.description: The table set of the slot, or null if it has none yet.

totalSeats.description: Seats of the slot: 0 when it has no table set.

Requirement.description: The saved dietary needs of one guest (MH-05). Texts are trimmed; a text that was not sent is null.

hasAllergies.description: True when the guest has at least one allergy (of the list or other): the kitchen must take special care. Worked out by the server.

RequirementRequest.description: The dietary needs of one guest (MH-05). At least one field must say something.

diets.description: The diets of the guest. At most one of VEGETARIAN, VEGAN and PESCATARIAN; LACTOSE_FREE can go with any of them.

otherDiet.description: A diet that is not in the list, in words (the *Other* diet card), e.g. halal.

allergies.description: Any number of allergies of the list, each once.

otherAllergy.description: An allergy that is not in the list, in words (the *Other* allergy card), e.g. sesame.

otherRequests.description: Anything else the kitchen should know that is not a diet or an allergy, e.g. no spicy food.

MyBooking.description: A booking of the logged-in hiker (MH-06). `canChange` and `changeableUntil` are in the list of `GET /api/bookings`, not in the answer of a change.

id.description: Identifier of the booking. The booking reference of the emails is `QUOTA-` and this number on five digits.

startsAt.description: Start of the slot, local time of the hut (HH:MM).

endsAt.description: End of the slot, local time of the hut (HH:MM).

tables.description: The tables of the party, by table number.

requirements.description: The dietary needs, one line per guest who has any.

canChange.description: True while the booking can still be changed: until 48 hours before the meal.

changeableUntil.description: The last moment of a change, local date and time of the hut (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM).

ChangeBookingRequest.description: What changes: at least one field. What is not sent stays as it is. The tables are chosen by the server.

slotId.description: The slot to move to. It must be at least 48 hours away and have tables.

requirements.description: The new dietary needs: they replace all the old lines; `[]` removes them. At most one line per person of the (new) party.
